vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: mkts-market-data
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle is benign. All `curl` commands and agent instructions in `SKILL.md` are directly related to querying market data and managing a portfolio/journal on the `mkts.io` platform. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection attempts designed to make the agent perform actions outside the stated purpose. The `POST /register` command, while making an external call, is explicitly for obtaining an API key for the `mkts.io` service itself and uses a placeholder email, not a real one.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are consistent with a market-data wrapper for the mkts.io API and do not request unrelated credentials or install code, but the publisher/source is unknown so exercise normal caution before trusting API keys or portfolio writes.

dimensions.detail: Name and description (market data) match the instructions: the SKILL.md contains curl examples for fetching market data, quotes, news, and portfolio endpoints. Required binary (curl) and optional MKTS_API_KEY are appropriate. Note: the skill's source/homepage is missing in the registry metadata, so provenance is limited.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions only show HTTP requests to https://mkts.io/api/v1 and an optional registration POST to that domain. The SKILL.md does not instruct reading local files, other env vars, or sending data to unrelated endpoints. It does include portfolio write operations (POST/DELETE) — expected for a portfolio feature but these will modify server-side state and require an API key.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files; this minimizes on-disk execution risk. The declared dependency on curl is reasonable.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables; MKTS_API_KEY is listed as optional and is used only to increase rate limits and authenticate portfolio operations. The number and type of env vars are proportionate to the described features.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always-enabled and does not request system-wide config or credentials. It can be invoked by the agent (normal), and there is no instruction to modify other skills or global agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a straightforward instruction-only wrapper around mkts.io's HTTP API. Before installing: (1) confirm the mkts.io domain and service legitimacy (there is no homepage listed in the registry metadata); (2) avoid registering or storing API keys with sensitive or primary email addresses if you have privacy concerns; (3) treat any API key (MKTS_API_KEY) as a secret — only provide it if you trust the service and its storage/rotation policies; (4) be aware the portfolio write endpoints will change data server-side, so only use them if you intend to store holdings on mkts.io; and (5) monitor network use and review the service's privacy/security documentation if you plan to trust it with personal or financial data.
